_comment_: Tier-2 large-domain lobe sweep. Single difference vs ResMill examples/dataset_generation/config_full_lobes.json: the build grid is 208x208x50 cropped to 192x192x32 instead of 80x80x50 cropped to 64x64x32. Cell size is IDENTICAL (100 m in x/y, 1 m in z) and every physics parameter range is byte-identical, so bodies keep their physical size and only the domain grows. Purpose: make a 64x64x32 tile a genuine interior window of a larger field, so MultiDiffusion tiles have the correct marginal and context-slab conditioning is in-distribution.
